The home mountain of the Greek Gods is Mount Olympus.

To understand the concept of search engines using the provided analogy: Imagine the Internet is like a massive, chaotic library where every book represents a website and every page within those books is a web page. If you are looking for specific information, it would be nearly impossible to read every single page manually. This is where a search engine like Google acts like a highly efficient library index or catalog system. Just as a library index helps you quickly locate the exact book and page you need without scanning every shelf, a search engine helps you instantly find the specific website and web page that contains the answer to your query.
